g.text: PROBLEM COPING
fix it: plan, act,
seek help!
EMOTION COPING
soothe it: pray,
share, reframe!
CRISIS: ACT NOW
safety + simplify +
support + follow!
DEFENCES (Freud)
denial, projection,
rationalising…
RESPECT THEN
gently reality-test
— never strip!
COPING TWINS (Lazarus!): PROBLEM-focused (fixable? PLAN + act + help-seek!) +
EMOTION-focused (unfixable? PRAY + share + reframe + rest!). Match to control: exams →
study-plan; dying → presence + prayer. Mismatches harm (planning the unplannable!).
CRISIS (Caplan!): threat + can't cope + overwhelmed — 4-6 WEEK window: intervene or
maladaptation hardens! Steps: SAFETY first (suicide? harm? — COM!) → SIMPLIFY (one step!)
→ SUPPORT (stay! family! faith!) → PLAN (resources + referrals!) → FOLLOW-UP (call!). Grief,
diagnosis, assault, disaster — same steps, every storm.
DEFENCES (Freud — exam list!): DENIAL ("no cancer!") · PROJECTION ("nurses hate me" — own
anger!) · RATIONALISING ("missed drugs — pharmacy's fault!") · DISPLACEMENT (shout at nurse,
angry at diagnosis!) · REGRESSION (baby-talk!) · REPRESSION (can't recall trauma!) ·
SUBLIMATION (grief → volunteering — HEALTHY!) · HUMOUR (gallows jokes coping!).
NURSE + DEFENCES: RESPECT first (shock-absorbers!) → meet NEED beneath (fear? shame?) →
GENTLY reality-test ("the scan shows… shall we plan…?") → NEVER strip ("stop denying!")
→ strengthen healthy (sublimation! humour! faith!). Exam: name it + nurse it.
FAMILY COPING: include + inform + respite ("rest — I'll call!") + watch hidden carers
(daughters dropping school!). Carer burnout = second patient — screen + support (GER!).
LINKS: COM storms/grief · GER carers · PRO-II resilience.
MANTRA: "fix what's fixable, soothe what's not, never strip defences."
